label: politically controls
definition: Political group X controls or gains control of political body Y.
scope_notes: Control, take-control, retain-control, win-control and regain-control collectively define the coherent political-control component. Generic win/be-in and sporting tournament paths form competing components; they are not combined into a generic success relation. Winning control or historical control qualifies, mere presence or membership does not.

facts.reason: Mr. Bush is merely in Washington; no row establishes political control of a political body.
Knicks have, lose and play Patrick Ewing, describing a team-player relationship rather than political control.
Republicans explicitly take, hold, win, retain and keep control of the House.
Patriots win and play in the Super Bowl; a sports championship is outside the selected political-control predicate.
Democrats include and are led by Hillary Rodham Clinton; this neither makes her a controlled political body nor establishes control in the selected direction.
